summary: @servicetitan/unit-tests preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall=`node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex `_0x...` identifiers, property-lookup indirection) and, on install, probes for the Bun runtime and — if absent — downloads a Bun release archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip, extracts it, chmods 0755, then execFileSync's the downloaded Bun binary against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB obfuscated bundle (starts with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, uses a string-array rotation decoder `hc1jfK9` / `WV8StW` and a large numeric/character lookup table; network destinations are reconstructed at runtime rather than appearing as plain-text URLs). The package's advertised purpose is a thin re-export of ts-mockito (dist/index.js) and has no legitimate need for an alternate language runtime or a heavily obfuscated multi-hundred-KB sibling payload. The result on `npm install` is that an opaque, obfuscated JavaScript payload is executed under a freshly-downloaded second runtime, bypassing tooling that only inspects Node-resolved code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
